name: Steps Meeting / Mens Group - Closed Meeting
notes:
Zoom only meeting
Sydney based, all locations welcome.
Closed Meetings are open only to those individuals who have a desire to stop their addictive sexual behaviour.
Open Meetings are open to anyone interested in finding out about SAA; those who attend need not have admitted that their sexual behavior is a problem.
Online meetings are only actively running with a host as per the above schedule.
About Sydney Zoom Meetings
Zoom Instructions for Participants or Secretaries:
SAA_Online_Meetings__Instructions_for_Participants_v1.1.pdf
SAA_Online_Meetings__Instructions_for_Secretaries_v1.1.pdf
If you are unable to use Zoom or do not have a compatible device, Sydney online meetings are also accessible via direct dial-in phone numbers. Simply call any of the following local Australian numbers from your landline or mobile phone & follow the prompts to enter the meeting (please use Meeting ID: 183 437 887):
(02) 8015 6011
(03) 7018 2005
(08) 7150 1149
